To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the likelihood of termination of a provincial leader decreases with the economic performance of the province during his term of office, while the likelihood increases with his average economic performance.

the likelihood of termination of top provincial leaders increases with the economic performance of their predecessors and decreases with the average economic performance of the province over their tenure, but the likelihood of promotion increases with the average economic per- formance of their province over their tenure and decreases with the economic performance under their leadership.
the turnover of China's provincial leaders is positively correlated with their economic performance and that the turnover is more sensitive to average performance than to annual performance.
